new.question: What is the percentage of the customers who used EUR in 2012/8/25?
new.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT IIF(T2.Currency = 'EUR', T1.CustomerID, NULL)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25'

candidate.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';
